continuous: Every change to the main branch of a public repository goes through a pull request reviewed by GitHub Copilot.
Every parser is fuzzed on each pull request and nightly.
Dependencies: known advisories, licences and sources checked on each pull request; registry signatures verified in CI; routine updates wait 7 days after release (security updates don't wait).
Secret scanning with push protection on every repository.
Shared protocol test vectors, checked byte for byte by the core, the relay and both apps.
Power-cut tests: unsealing is cut at every step and must resume without losing anything.
